result: Learning a single ReLU neuron under Gaussian inputs: with one student neuron GD converges exponentially, but with n ≥ 2 student neurons randomly initialized GD converges at rate Θ(T^{−3}) (upper bound for GD, matching lower bound for gradient flow) — mild over-parameterization exponentially slows down convergence.
result_plain: Over-parameterization slows GD on a single ReLU neuron from exp(−T) to Θ(T^−3).
